get.description: Retrieves the time tracking settings configured for a department.

put.description: Updates an existing time tracking configuration.

post.description: Creates a time tracking configuration for the help desk.

get.summary: Get Time Tracking Settings Billing History
get.description: Retrieves the history of changes made to billing preferences in time tracking settings. The supported event types are: BILLING_PREFERENCE_ENABLED, BILLING_PREFERENCE_DISABLED, BILLING_TYPE_SELECTED, BILLING_TYPE_CHANGED, FIXED_COST_ENTERED, FIXED_COST_EDITED, AGENT_ADDED, AGENT_COST_EDITED, AGENT_DELETED, PROFILE_ADDED, PROFILE_COST_EDITED, and PROFILE_DELETED.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number from which the events must be fetched.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of events to fetch. Defaults to 20 if not provided.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Secondary information to include in the response. Possible values: owner

autoTrackAction.description: Auto-tracking actions configured for ticket activity

resolutionActions.description: Indicates whether resolution actions trigger auto-tracking. Possible values: true = enabled, false = disabled
